title: I didn’t think I was gonna be able to see any theater in Ireland, but...
transcript: Day two of my trip to Dublin to See Noah Kahan. Going to the concert tonight, and now I'm going to the theatre. My friend messaged me that there's a show that's closing tonight, in Dublin it’s a new play And it was at 2:30 and the concert is at 7. And I was like, you know what? Let's do it. I bought like the second to last ticket. to this play i’m in the front of a double decker bus i’m very excited. The rain's honestly not bad. to be in the bus for an hour, it's raining. I'm at two minutes from the theatre right now. So I don’t have to go too far Here we go. Love that I found theater. It's amazing. Okay, wait. I love this play so much. It's like a little John Proctor, a little of the wolves. Like, it's. It's girlhood. Kinda jumps back and forth. It reminds me of that TV Show Bad Sisters. But maybe it's cause they're all irish. But actually have to stand here for an hour, I am really happy I brought a coat. A lot of people do not have coats, and I don't know how they're doing it, cause it is chilly.
classificationReason: Creator saw a closing-night play in Dublin and expresses love for it ('I love this play so much'), but never names the show. No match can be confirmed from the provided list.
